articles.title: Will Stein's offense off to historic start in Kentucky football debut
articles.summary: Will Stein made a significant impression in his debut as Kentucky's football coach. His team achieved a strong offensive start in Game 1, exceeding the 30-point mark by the third quarter, primarily due to a touchdown reception by Prince Jean. This initial performance signifies a promising start under Coach Stein's leadership for the UK football program.
